text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
――Alright, I'll go ahead and add the tail hole for this one!
It will be ready for pickup in one week, so please drop by whenever you have time.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, .
I'll be sure to visit again.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
A-And—I'm so sorry, Trainer.
For keeping you tagging along with me all this time.
choice_data_list: Not at all, it's a great breather for me.

text_block_list.text:
Today, I went shopping with Ryoka Tsurugi.
She wanted to pick out some clothes to gift Sonon Elfie,
so I accompanied her for a while.
choice_data_list: Do you often pick out clothes for her?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... She often mentioned that
when she picks outfits herself,
she prioritizes ease of movement far too much.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I helped pick out an outfit once and she loved it, so ever since then... I suppose?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for consulting with me today.
Thanks to you, I was able to pick something
she's sure to love.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Next time, wouldn't you allow me to accompany you
to wherever you'd like to go, Trainer?

Hearing that, what suddenly came to mind...
was the park food truck that had been
trending on social media a while ago.
Apparently it just opened recently, and you can get delicious kebabs there.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it over there?
Wow, it's so lively...!
choice_data_list: Looks like there'll be a line, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, not a problem at all.
I'd like to check out trendy spots myself.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Shall we head over right away, Trainer?
So, we headed over to the buzzing food truck... and after waiting in line for a bit, we managed to get our kebabs.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Well then, thank you for the meal.
...――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Whoa, delicious...!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The fruity sauce gives a refreshing touch...
and yet it's deeply savory and hearty—a wonderful balance.
It's a flavor people of all ages can enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Doner kebabs are quite visually striking, so I can see
why they capture the hearts of park visitors.
Hehe... This was a very helpful reference for future ideas.
choice_data_list: (Her way of thinking is as mature and grounded as ever.)

text_block_list.text:
She remained just as brisk and efficient even on her day off.
Internally marveling at her demeanor, I savored my kebab,
when――

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Coo, coo-roo-coo!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
choice_data_list: Whoa!? No way, I'm not giving it to you.

text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, a pigeon had crept up
and nearly pecked away my kebab.

Looking around, I noticed quite a few birds gathering...
Could they be hanging around hoping for leftover food scraps?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
choice_data_list: Haha, that was quite a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes!?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, um, no, ...y-yes.
It was quite a surprise, wasn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, haha.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me.
Could we please step away from here...?

...Looking visibly off and rather awkward,
she strides briskly onward.
And once we make it just outside the park—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I've calmed down.
I'm sorry for being so sudden...

I shake my head "no, no," but think it over.
Reflecting on everything since that pigeon appeared, could it be...?
choice_data_list: Are you not good with birds……?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...It is rather pathetic of me, but...

text_block_list.name: Gluttonous Bird
text_block_list.text: (FLUTTER-FLUTTER!)

text_block_list.name: Young Ryoka
text_block_list.text: "Eeeek?!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...When I was little, a bird went after my food.
For three days after that, I had nightmares about being carried off by a giant bird and dropped from the sky...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Could you please keep this a secret……?
Especially from Elfie, please……!
choice_data_list: O-Of course I won't say a word!

text_block_list.text: Seeing her sigh in relief, a small secret had formed between the two of us.
